thread:
Samir (PM): Hey all — PRD draft for the Consensus Playbook is up: https://redwood.docs/prd/consensus-playbook-draft. Need cross-team review + signoff on gating criteria, acceptance checklist, and edge cases before we freeze scope next Tue. Please read and add comments. TL;DR: customer-driven asks prioritized, must satisfy latency < 150ms P95 for hosted tier, and have rollback plan. :eyes:

Maya (Product Ops): Skimming now. Can we add clear A/B rollout gates and monitoring signals? suggest: error rate >0.5% or latency >200ms => auto-rollback.

Andre (Eng): We need to quantify SLOs per model size. Also need infra estimate — dedicated capacity needed for peak QPS. Ping infra for numbers.

Priya (Design): UX edgecases — rate-limited responses, partial content, streaming interruptions. I'll add acceptance examples and fallback copy.

Leah (CS): Priority flag from Atlas customer. They've asked for per-tenant isolation and audit logs. Is that on scope for v1?

Taylor (Legal): Data residency note — for EU tenants we need KMS integration and audit fields. Add to non-functional reqs.

Andre (Eng): Quick status: prototype latency for 8k context model on current infra is 160ms P95. With batching down to ~140ms. I'll put numbers in the doc.

Samir (PM): Thanks. Two asks: 1) Add a clear "must-have" vs "nice-to-have" list in PRD. 2) If any team cannot sign off by Fri EOD, flag here.

Priya (Design): Added acceptance snips and edgecase flows. Example: user cancels mid-stream -> server must return partial structured JSON and flag event 'stream_cancelled'.

Maya (Product Ops): Drafted rollout checklist. Important lines: smoke tests, canary to 5% traffic, observability dashboards live, cost runbook.

Andre (Eng): Noted infra risk: dedicated pool scaling latency may spike under cold start. Proposed mitigation: warm standby nodes + pre-warming script in deploy pipeline.

Samir (PM): Great. Can folks reply with :thumbsup: when they can sign off on gating checklist? We'll collate a decision log after signoffs.

deply-bot: New doc uploaded: https://redwood.docs/prd/consensus-playbook-draft (version 3) — changed sections: infra estimates, acceptance criteria.

Maya (Product Ops): :thumbsup:

Leah (CS): :thumbsup: pending audit log design confirmation.

Priya (Design): :thumbsup:

Andre (Eng): :thumbsup: will add final numbers by Thu.

Taylor (Legal): :eyes: need one change, will post comment inline.

Samir (PM): Thanks all — I'll capture the decision log and set freeze at next Tue 9am PT.
